summary: Ran 3 focused public-page frontend tests on DynoPay preview per review request. All three assertions PASS. T1 (checkout title + inline verified badge): h1 'Pay The Dev Store' renders with computed font-size 24px on desktop (1920x800) and 20px on mobile (390x844); data-testid=public-verified-badge exists INSIDE the h1 as an inline SVG icon (aria-label 'Verified merchant'); no visible 'Verified merchant' text anywhere on page; hover tooltip is exactly 'Verified merchant — identity checked by Dynopay'; no horizontal overflow. T2 (success card, no confetti): mocked addPayment/verifyCryptoPayment (pending→confirmed)/setCustomerEmail/receipt; selected default USDT-Polygon and clicked clean-checkout-continue-btn; clean-checkout-success-icon appeared; 0 canvases and 0 position:fixed canvases both immediately and 2s after success (confetti fully removed); 'Paid to The Dev Store' text contains inline public-verified-badge; no visible 'Verified merchant' text on success card; only a benign 403 resource error (favicon/analytics) in console. T3 (devhub storefront checkout): seeded dynopay_cart_v1 localStorage, navigated to /devhub/checkout; data-testid=checkout-merchant-name is followed by icon-only data-testid=public-verified-badge in the same parent container; no visible 'Verified merchant' text. No pay-flow clicks on T3.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicVerifiedBadge renders after merchant-verification API resolves; initial DOM has badge_count=0 for ~1-2s. Not a bug but tests must wait for network idle or explicitly wait for the badge before asserting existence.

rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. All three requested checks pass on public URL. Mocks: /api/pay/addPayment, /api/pay/verifyCryptoPayment* (pending→confirmed), /api/pay/setCustomerEmail, /api/pay/receipt** all fulfilled.
